visual.observation: The video shows the word "SAFE" followed by a laptop interface containing a wallet icon, and later multiple devices connected around a central circle labeled "OneCoin" with coin graphics.

visual.potential_relevance: A safety claim is visually associated with a named cryptocurrency-like system and wallet-style interfaces, which conditionally merits review because the claim is linked to handling digital-value accounts or assets.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show spoken claims, terms of service, actual transactions, user losses, or whether any wallet function is real.

visual.observation: A smartphone displays a green "PAY" button beneath icons including a laptop with a graduation-cap symbol, a block of alphanumeric-looking strings, and a globe with a circular arrow.
visual.context: The frame appears to be part of an animated explanation involving payment and globally circulating digital information; the exact offer or product is not fully visible.
visual.potential_relevance: A visible payment action is presented alongside education-like content and digital-address-like strings, creating an observed relationship between paying and participation in a digital or training-related system.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish who receives payment, what amount is requested, what the user obtains, or whether the strings represent real addresses or illustrative text.

visual.observation: On-screen text reads "Inspired by Dr. Ruja Ignatova's strong vision" next to an illustrated woman.
visual.context: The text presents a named person as inspiration for the depicted project or message; no denial or warning context is visible in this sampled frame.
visual.potential_relevance: A named-person endorsement or leadership-style claim is linked to the surrounding OneCoin-themed content, which conditionally merits review because identity claims can influence trust in requested participation or payment flows shown elsewhere.
visual.limitations: The frame does not verify the person's role, consent, identity, or any outcome connected to the claim.

visual.observation: A final contact screen shows "One Team international" with social media handles, a red "Подписаться" subscribe button, and the website text "www.1coin.team".
visual.context: The screen functions as an audience-navigation or contact panel for the One Team international identity; the Russian button text means "Subscribe".

visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show what happens after subscribing or visiting the website, and the URL or accounts have not been verified.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it affirmatively promotes OneCoin through a cryptocurrency participation-and-returns mechanism and an invitation to join the financial movement. It also connects the system to mobile money transfers, a one-minute worldwide transfer claim, and absolute safety assertions reinforced by wallet imagery and a prominent "SAFE" visual. The title and description leave some informational or news framing possible, and the records do not establish completed transactions, losses, or the truth of the claims.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The narration associates buying coins with receiving a later share of coins, supporting a token-purchase-linked future benefit. The wording does not establish a guaranteed outcome or a precise return.
